# Acceptance Process

## Short Definition
Increasing willingness to contact unwanted internal experience without immediate control or escape.

## Practical Description
Values-based action links chosen life directions to concrete behavior, helping the person move toward meaning even when difficult internal experiences are present.

## Therapeutic Change Processes
Contact with values increases willingness to experience difficult emotions.
